declaration.preface: At Stella Hospitality, we are committed to upholding the highest standards of labor and human rights across our operations and supply chain. We believe that a safe, fair, and inclusive work environment is essential for the well-being of our employees, business partners, and stakeholders. This policy outlines our commitment to fair wages, safe working conditions, non-discrimination, ethical labor practices, and human dignity in line with international labor standards. We expect all employees, suppliers, and business partners to adhere to these principles, ensuring that Stella Hospitality remains a responsible and ethical employer. This policy is regularly reviewed and updated to align with evolving human rights and labor standards.
declaration.declaration: At Stella Hospitality, we are dedicated to fostering an inclusive, ethical, and fair work environment by upholding the highest standards of labor and human rights across all our operations and supply chains. We recognize our responsibility to ensure fair treatment, safe working conditions, and respect for human dignity while promoting diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI). Our commitment is reflected in the following key areas:
declaration.scope: This Labor and Human Rights Policy applies to all employees, contractors, suppliers, business partners, and stakeholders associated with Stella Hospitality. It is applicable to all site locations:

focusAreas: Compliance with Labor Laws & Global Standards

Fair & Ethical Working Conditions: We ensure that all employees, contractors, and supply chain partners operate under fair and ethical working conditions. This includes providing fair wages, reasonable working hours, rest periods, and a respectful, harassment-free workplace.
We conduct annual wage assessments to ensure fair and competitive compensation, aligning with international labor standards and regional regulations.
Health, Safety & Well-being: We prioritize the health, safety, and well-being of our employees by maintaining safe and hygienic workplaces, enforcing occupational health standards, and providing necessary training and protective equipment.
Regular health and safety audits are conducted across all facilities to identify and mitigate risks, ensuring a safe working environment for all employees.
Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI): Stella Hospitality is committed to creating a workplace that embraces diversity and ensures equal opportunities for all, regardless of gender, race, age, nationality, disability, or background. We actively promote an inclusive work environment that fosters respect and belonging.
Annual unconscious bias and DEI training sessions are provided for management and hiring teams to foster an inclusive and equitable workplace.
Prevention of Child & Forced Labor: We have a zero-tolerance policy against child labor, forced labor. We require all our suppliers and business partners to adhere to strict ethical labor standards.
Career Growth & Employee Development: We support our employees' professional growth through continuous training, career advancement programs, and leadership development initiatives to foster long-term success.
Skill development programs are implemented to provide continuous learning opportunities, ensuring all employees have access to career advancement initiatives.
Freedom of Association & Employee Rights: We respect and uphold employees’ rights to organize, participate in collective bargaining, and voice concerns without fear of retaliation. Open communication and structured social dialogue are encouraged at all levels.
Whistleblower Protection & Grievance Mec: We maintain strict whistleblower protection policies, allowing employees and stakeholders to report any labor rights violations confidentially and without retaliation. A structured grievance redressal mechanism ensures fair resolution of workplace concerns.
A confidential and accessible grievance system is in place to allow employees to report concerns safely, with a commitment to timely resolution and fair treatment.
Compliance with Labor Laws & Global Stan: We fully comply with all national and international labor laws and local labor regulations. We continuously seek third-party certifications and independent audits to ensure alignment with global labor rights standards.
Fair Wage Assessments: We conduct annual wage assessments to ensure fair and competitive compensation, aligning with international labor standards and regional regulations.
Workplace Safety Audits: Regular health and safety audits are conducted across all facilities to identify and mitigate risks, ensuring a safe working environment for all employees.
Diversity & Inclusion Training: Annual unconscious bias and DEI training sessions are provided for management and hiring teams to foster an inclusive and equitable workplace.
Employee Development Programs: Skill development programs are implemented to provide continuous learning opportunities, ensuring all employees have access to career advancement initiatives.
Transparent Grievance Mechanisms: A confidential and accessible grievance system is in place to allow employees to report concerns safely, with a commitment to timely resolution and fair treatment.

targets.target: Achieve zero workplace fatalities by 2028 through enhanced safety training and risk mitigation programs.
Ensure 100% of employees undergo health and safety training at least once per year by 2028.
Conduct 100% compliance audits for occupational health and safety standards by 2028.
Maintain 100% compliance with international labor standards by 2028.
Implement ergonomic workplace improvements in all office facilities by 2028.
Conduct annual employee satisfaction surveys, targeting a 10% increase in employee well-being scores by 2028.
Ensure 100% of employees have access to skill development programs by 2028.
Increase annual training hours per employee by 30% by 2028, focusing on leadership, sustainability, and hospitality industry advancements.
Launch a women’s leadership program with a goal of 40% female representation in management roles by 2028.
Implement equal pay for equal work, with a goal of closing gender pay gaps by 2028.
Establish inclusive hiring policies, ensuring at least 5% of new hires come from underrepresented groups by 2028.
Conduct annual unconscious bias and DEI training for 100% of management and hiring teams.

policy.monitoring:
To ensure the effectiveness of Stella Hospitality’s Labor and Human Rights Policy, a structured monitoring and reporting framework is essential. This ensures transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement in workplace conditions, employee well-being, and ethical business practices.

Regular internal audits are conducted to assess compliance with labor laws, workplace safety, DEI initiatives, and employee welfare.

Key performance indicators (KPIs) such as workplace safety incidents, training hours, employee satisfaction, and diversity metrics are tracked.

Employees have access to anonymous reporting channels for workplace concerns related to discrimination, unfair labor practices, or unsafe working conditions.

Regular supplier audits ensure compliance with labor rights, ethical sourcing, and fair employment practices across the supply chain.

The Policy is publicly available on Stella Hospitality’s website and shared through various stakeholder communication channels.

Employees are kept informed of updates and expected to integrate these practices into their work.
policy.reviewMechanism:
The Human Resources Department is responsible for overseeing the implementation and review of this Labor and Human Rights Policy. This policy will be reviewed annually to ensure its effectiveness and alignment with evolving labor laws, industry standards, and organizational commitments.

Any updates or modifications will be communicated to all stakeholders to ensure continued compliance and adaptation to changing labor rights challenges.
